_comment: d1 #247 Friends of the Inn PR2a -- Pisces's INN register. Attached ONLY to the pisces_inn_guest entity; his street hub (pisces_magic) never rides along, so the magic tutoring, the necromancy defence and EVERY door consult stay home-only (REGISTER-PURE, spec 2026-07-20-foti-pr2-spec.md -- reinforced now that door_mounting.json exists on this same map: the guest row must never touch door mechanics). A magic question is DEFLECTED in the greet, never answered. Serve mirrors selys_inn/patron_serving: {once_per_waking, item} sanctioned compound, banks the shared served_customer counter. Voice per docs/design/character-profiles.md: haughty THAWING -- performatively above tavern food while visibly enjoying it.

greet.speaker: Pisces
greet.text: You are the one with the trays. I am not here for the cuisine, you understand, nor to discuss my work over it. The fire is adequate. My rooms are not.

options.text: Bring him a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)

offduty.speaker: Pisces
offduty.text: Tavern fare is a solved problem. Salt, fat, and enough of it that nobody asks a second question. I have eaten better in three cities. I have eaten considerably worse in nine. I decline to say where this kitchen falls between them.

options.text: Bring him a bowl from the kitchen. (Serve)

served.speaker: Pisces
served.text: ...Hm. It is competent. Do not read anything into that; I have called far worse things competent. Though I observe that I have finished it, and I observe you observing.
